docs.title: Step 6: proxy.ts, the request hook
docs.text:
Next.js 16 runs servers/nextjs/proxy.ts (the file convention formerly called middleware) before routing. Its matcher covers every path except _next/static and favicon.ico (servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:174-176). The function makes decisions in a fixed order:

flowchart TD
  R["request"] --> DT{"desktopRequestDenied()"}
  DT -- "denied" --> X1["401, 403 or 503 JSON"]
  DT -- "ok" --> P{"path is /api/*, /app_data*, /static* or /pdf-maker?"}
  P -- "no" --> N1["NextResponse.next(): page routes, guarded by layouts"]
  P -- "/app_data or /static" --> RW1["rewrite to FastAPI"]
  P -- "/pdf-maker" --> PM{"exportSession query param?"}
  PM -- "yes" --> RD["302 to same URL without param + Set-Cookie presenton_session"]
  PM -- "no" --> N2["next()"]
  P -- "/api/*" --> AD{"isAuthDisabled()"}
  AD -- "yes" --> CR["continueRequest"]
  AD -- "no" --> EX{"OPTIONS or exempt path?"}
  EX -- "yes" --> CR
  EX -- "no" --> AK{"Authorization: Bearer sk-presenton-...?"}
  AK -- "yes, /api/v1 or /api/v2" --> RW2["rewrite to FastAPI (FastAPI validates key)"]
  AK -- "yes, other /api" --> F403["403 API keys are only accepted by the Presenton API"]
  AK -- "no" --> AS["GET /api/v1/auth/status with request cookies"]
  AS -- "authenticated" --> CR
  AS -- "not configured" --> S428["428 setup_required"]
  AS -- "otherwise" --> S401["401 Unauthorized"]
  CR --> V{"/api/v1 or /api/v2?"}
  V -- "yes" --> RW3["rewrite to FastAPI"]
  V -- "no" --> N3["next(): Next.js API route"]

docs.title: 6.1 The FastAPI base URL
docs.text: getFastApiBaseUrl() resolves FAST_API_INTERNAL_URL, then NEXT_PUBLIC_FAST_API, then http://127.0.0.1:8000, stripping trailing slashes (servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:10-23). rewriteToFastApi() keeps the original path and query string (:43-49). The comment at :107-109 explains why the rewrite is done at request time: in Docker, nginx already routes /api/v1, /api/v2, /app_data and /static to FastAPI, but Electron has no nginx and picks random loopback ports at start-up, so the destination cannot be baked into Next.js's build-time route manifest.

docs.title: 6.2 Path classes
docs.text:
Class Test Lines FastAPI API /api/v1, /api/v1/*, /api/v2, /api/v2/* servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:25-32 FastAPI assets /app_data, /app_data/*, /static, /static/* servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:34-41 Auth-exempt API /api/v1/auth/*, /api/telemetry-status, /api/update-svg, /api/export-presentation-data/* servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:87-95

Everything else under /api/ is a Next.js API route (Step 10) and needs a valid session.

docs.title: 6.3 The /pdf-maker cookie handoff
docs.text:
The export pipeline opens /pdf-maker?id=...&exportSession=<token> in a headless browser that has no cookies. The proxy converts the query parameter into a cookie and redirects to the clean URL:

servers/nextjs/proxy.ts (excerpt)
  if (pathname === "/pdf-maker") {
    const exportSession = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("exportSession");
    if (exportSession) {
      const redirectUrl = request.nextUrl.clone();
      redirectUrl.searchParams.delete("exportSession");

      const response = NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl);
      response.cookies.set({
        name: SESSION_COOKIE_NAME,
        value: exportSession,
        maxAge: SESSION_TTL_SECONDS,
        httpOnly: true,
        secure:
          request.headers.get("x-forwarded-proto")?.toLowerCase() === "https" ||
          request.nextUrl.protocol === "https:",
        sameSite: "lax",
        path: "/",
      });
      return response;
    }

SESSION_COOKIE_NAME is presenton_session and SESSION_TTL_SECONDS is 30 days (servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:62-63). The token is not validated here; it becomes the session cookie and FastAPI validates it on the next API call. The rest of the export flow is in PPTX and PDF export.

docs.title: 6.4 API keys
docs.text: Admin-issued API keys have the prefix sk-presenton-. A request whose Authorization header starts with bearer sk-presenton- (compared lowercase) is passed straight through to FastAPI for /api/v1 and /api/v2 paths, without a cookie check, because FastAPI owns key validation. The same header on any Next.js API route gets a 403 with {"detail": "API keys are only accepted by the Presenton API"} (servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:146-156). This keeps API keys away from local configuration routes like /api/user-config.

docs.title: 6.5 Session status responses
docs.text: For everything else the proxy calls FastAPI GET /api/v1/auth/status forwarding the cookie header (servers/nextjs/proxy.ts:65-85). An error or non-2xx is treated as {configured: true, authenticated: false}, which yields 401. A deployment with no account yet yields 428 {"detail": "Login setup is required", "setup_required": true}. Both carry Cache-Control: no-store (:158-171).

docs.title: 6.6 The desktop transport guard
docs.text:
When PRESENTON_ELECTRON === "true", desktopRequestDenied() runs first for every matched request, including pages (servers/nextjs/lib/desktop-auth.ts:14-44). It requires PRESENTON_DESKTOP_TOKEN to be at least 32 characters and PRESENTON_DESKTOP_ORIGINS to be non-empty (else 503), the Host header to match one of those origins and any Origin header to be one of them (else 403), and the token to arrive either in the x-presenton-desktop-token header or the presenton_desktop_session cookie, compared with timingSafeEqual (else 401). Details belong to Electron desktop app.

Gotcha

The proxy calls FastAPI's /api/v1/auth/status for every authenticated Next.js API request and every proxied /api/v1 or /api/v2 call. That is one extra in-cluster HTTP round trip per API request. If you add a high-frequency endpoint, account for it, or add it to isApiAuthExempt() only if it is genuinely public.

docs.title: Step 7: How the browser picks the backend origin
docs.text:
Browser code never hardcodes the FastAPI host. It calls getApiUrl(path) from servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts.

servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts (excerpt)
export function getApiUrl(path: string): string {
  if (isAbsoluteHttpUrl(path)) {
    return path;
  }

  const normalizedPath = withLeadingSlash(path);
  const isFastApiEndpoint =
    normalizedPath.startsWith("/api/v1/") ||
    normalizedPath.startsWith("/api/v2/");
  if (!isFastApiEndpoint) {
    return normalizedPath;
  }

  if (typeof window === "undefined" && !getConfiguredFastApiUrl()) {
    return normalizedPath;
  }

  return resolveBackendPathForRuntime(normalizedPath);
}

The decision table:

Runtime Result for /api/v1/... Source Browser, web or Docker, no fastapiUrl query relative path, same origin (nginx or proxy.ts forwards it) servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:88-100 Browser, Electron (window.electron exists) window.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FAST_API (or location.origin) + path servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:106-120 Browser, trusted ?fastapiUrl= query that origin + path servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:56-78 Server, no configured URL relative path servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:136-138 Non-API path such as /api/user-config always relative servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:132-134

The ?fastapiUrl= override exists for export pages, but it is deliberately narrow: the value is accepted only if its origin equals the configured NEXT_PUBLIC_FAST_API origin or the page's own origin (servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:63-74). A link can therefore select a backend the application already trusts, but never introduce a new destination for cookies or API keys. tests/backend-connectivity.test.mjs:46-68 checks this against look-alike hosts such as https://backend.example.evil.test and https://backend.example@collector.example.

docs.title: 7.1 Asset URL normalization
docs.text:
The backend stores image, upload and font paths in several shapes (absolute file paths, file: URLs, absolute URLs on its own origin, relative paths). resolveBackendAssetUrl() (servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:292-343) maps all of them to a URL the current runtime can load, using toBackendServedPath() (:232-269):

Input contains Output path Lines /_next/static/ or /vendor/fonts/ unchanged (served by Next.js) servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:236-241 /app_data/ slice from /app_data/ :243-246 /static/ slice from /static/ :248-251 last /images/ /app_data/images/... :253-256 last /uploads/ /app_data/uploads/... :258-261 last /fonts/ /app_data/fonts/... :263-266

data: and blob: URLs pass through; absolute URLs on any origin that is not one of this deployment's backends (configured, query, runtime, or page origin) are left alone so Presenton Cloud assets keep their full URL (:315-323). normalizeBackendAssetUrls() walks a whole JSON tree and rewrites every string that looks like an asset path (:395-416); the presentation loaders run every API response through it.

Gotcha

Server-side getFastAPIUrl() falls back to http://127.0.0.1:5001 (servers/nextjs/utils/api.ts:119), while proxy.ts, serverAuth.ts and lib/fastapi-internal.ts fall back to http://127.0.0.1:8000. In Docker both are normally overridden by environment variables, but in a bare local run the two defaults disagree.

docs.title: Step 8: The Redux store
docs.text:
The store combines four slices (servers/nextjs/store/store.ts:7-14):

servers/nextjs/store/store.ts (excerpt)
export const store = configureStore({
  reducer: {
    presentationGeneration: presentationGenerationReducer,
    pptGenUpload: pptGenUploadReducer,
    userConfig: userConfigReducer,
    undoRedo: undoRedoReducer,
  },
});

No middleware, persistence or RTK Query is configured; all network I/O happens in components and hooks, which dispatch plain actions.

docs.title: 8.1 presentationGeneration
docs.text:
State (servers/nextjs/store/slices/presentationGeneration.ts:53-79):

Field Type Initial Meaning presentation_id string or null null Active deck id; the outline page falls back to it when ?id is missing. isLoading boolean false Set false by setError; also read by autosave as a pause condition. isStreaming boolean or null null True while the presentation SSE stream is open; disables editing and autosave. outlines {content: string}[] [] Outline cards on the outline page, always passed through limitOutlines(). error string or null null Cleared by setPresentationId. presentationData PresentationData or null null The whole deck: metadata, slides, theme, layout, fonts. generationMetrics GenerationMetrics or null null Live token counts from Smart-mode streams. isSlidesRendered boolean false Has a reducer; no dispatcher in this snapshot. isLayoutLoading boolean false Read by autosave; no dispatcher in this snapshot. enableHtmlSelector boolean false Smart-mode "select an element for the AI" toggle. chatHtmlSelection ChatHtmlSelection or null null The element picked in a Smart slide, with its HTML and slide index.

GenerationMetrics (:40-51) has model, input_tokens, output_tokens, thinking_tokens, total_tokens, tokens_per_second, duration_seconds, estimated, thinking_tokens_estimated, supports_thinking.

Gotcha

The "dispatched from" column was built by collecting every symbol imported from store/slices/presentationGeneration across the Next.js source. Eleven action creators are never imported anywhere: setLoading, setLayoutLoading, setSlidesRendered, setError, deleteSlideOutline, addSlide, updateSlide, updateSlideContent, updateSlideImage, updateImageProperties and updateSlideIcon. The content-path ones are leftovers from the pre-Template-V2 editor, where slides were React components bound to slide.content by data paths. Today's standard slides are edited as slide.ui JSON (see Slide editor). Do not build new features on these reducers without checking that something renders their output.

docs.title: 8.2 pptGenUpload
docs.text: State {config: PresentationConfig or null, files: any} with one reducer, setPptGenUploadState, that overwrites both fields from the payload (servers/nextjs/store/slices/presentationGenUpload.ts:4-27). PresentationConfig (servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/upload/type.ts:122-132) has slides (string or null), language, prompt, tone, verbosity, instructions, includeTableOfContents, includeTitleSlide, webSearch. The upload page stores the form here so the outline page can show and regenerate from the same settings; files holds the decompose responses ([{name, file_path}] arrays).

docs.title: 8.3 userConfig
docs.text: State {role: "admin" or "user" or null, llm_config: LLMConfig} with initial llm_config = {LLM: "", IMAGE_PROVIDER: "gpt-image-1.5"} and role = null; reducers setLLMConfig (replace) and setUserRole (servers/nextjs/store/slices/userConfig.ts:4-28).

docs.title: 8.4 undoRedo
docs.text:
A deck-level history of slides arrays (servers/nextjs/store/slices/undoRedoSlice.ts:4-26):

Field Initial Meaning past [] Older snapshots, at most maxHistorySize. present null The current snapshot. future [] Snapshots available to redo. maxHistorySize 30 past.shift() drops the oldest beyond 30. isUndoRedoInProgress false Guard while an undo/redo is being applied. pendingHistorySkips 0 The next N addToHistory calls are ignored.

Actions: addToHistory({slides, actionType}), undo, redo, finishUndoRedo, clearHistory. finishUndoRedo is exported but nothing dispatches it in this snapshot; clearHistory is dispatched by usePresentationData on a fresh load and by the header's regenerate action. The skip counter is what stops the undo from recording itself: undo sets pendingHistorySkips = 1, and the autosave effect's next addToHistory (fired because presentationData changed) consumes it (:32-39, :88-105). Snapshots are compared by reference, which is valid because Immer replaces changed arrays (:46-58). How this interacts with the per-slide editor history is covered in Slide editor.

docs.title: Step 9: The API client layer
docs.text: Browser calls to FastAPI live in servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/services/api/. Every function uses getApiUrl() and funnels the response through ApiResponseHandler.

docs.title: 9.1 Shared plumbing
docs.text:
getHeader() returns Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json and three Access-Control-Allow-* headers; getHeaderForFormData() returns only the three CORS headers so the browser can set the multipart boundary (.../services/api/header.ts:1-17). The CORS headers are response headers and have no effect when sent on a request; they are harmless.

ApiResponseHandler.handleResponse(response, defaultMessage) (.../services/api/api-error-handler.ts:35-89):

  • 204 returns true; any other 2xx returns parsed JSON, or {} if parsing fails.
  • Errors parse {detail, message, error} with extractApiErrorMessage() (servers/nextjs/utils/apiErrorMessages.ts), trigger requestChatGptReauth() when the response matches the ChatGPT rules, and throw ApiResponseError with status, optional code, and retryable.
  • retryable comes from the body's retryable flag if present, else defaults to true for 408, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504 (servers/nextjs/utils/apiErrorMessages.ts:21-39).
  • If the error body is not JSON, a fixed message per status code is used (api-error-handler.ts:142-169).

handleResponseWithResult() (:92-139) is the non-throwing variant that returns {success, message}; delete calls use it.

Function Method and path Notes getTemplateSummaries(isDefault?, {presentonCloudOnly}) (:122) GET /api/v1/ppt/template/all page_size=100, optional default, presenton_cloud_only=true getTemplateDetails(id) (:142) GET /api/v1/ppt/template/{id} strips a template-v2- prefix first getTemplateTheme(id) (:153) GET /api/v1/ppt/template/{id}/theme 5 minute in-memory cache, in-flight de-duplication, 404 cached as null createTemplate(payload) (:205) POST /api/v1/ppt/template/async getRecentTemplateCreateTasks(from) (:219) GET /api/v1/async-tasks type=template.create, limit=50 retryTemplateCreateTask(id) (:237) POST /api/v1/ppt/template/async/{id}/retry deleteTemplate(id) (:256) DELETE /api/v1/ppt/template/{id} updateTemplate(id, payload) / updateTemplateMetadata (:281, :271) PATCH /api/v1/ppt/template/{id} createTemplateLayout(payload) (:300) POST /api/v1/ppt/template/layouts/create generateTemplateLayout(payload) (:322) POST /api/v1/ppt/template/layouts/generate

CommunityPresentationApi (.../services/api/community.ts): list(page = 1, pageSize = 8, signal, filters) calls GET /api/v1/ppt/community/presentations with order_by=priority, order=desc by default (:99-127), and getById(id) calls GET /api/v1/ppt/community/presentations/{id} (:129-135). Both convert a network failure into a retryable ApiResponseError with code community_backend_unreachable (:74-96).

The chat protocol is covered in Editing and chat assistant.

Several features bypass the service classes and call fetch(getApiUrl(...)) directly: the outline and presentation EventSource streams, provider model discovery in settings and onboarding, Codex and Presenton Cloud auth, and the admin panel (which uses relative /api/v1/admin/... paths). Those are covered where they are used.

docs.title: Step 10: Next.js API routes
docs.text:
The routes under servers/nextjs/app/api/ run inside the Next.js server. They exist for work that needs the Next.js filesystem view, server-only secrets, or a same-origin endpoint.

Route Method Auth inside the handler Purpose /api/user-config GET authenticated; admins get FastAPI's real settings, others get the redacted config servers/nextjs/app/api/user-config/route.ts:39-67 /api/user-config POST requireAdminApi(); Content-Type must be application/json (415 otherwise); body must be a JSON object (400) forwards as PUT /api/v1/admin/provider-settings (:69-104) /api/runtime-config GET authenticated readRuntimeProviderConfig(): {configured, config} with secrets redacted (servers/nextjs/app/api/runtime-config/route.ts:7-20) /api/telemetry-status GET none (exempt in proxy) {telemetryEnabled} from DISABLE_ANONYMOUS_TRACKING in env or the user config file /api/has-required-key GET none in handler (proxy requires a session) {hasKey}: whether OPENAI_API_KEY exists in the config file or env. Nothing in the Next.js source calls it. /api/read-file POST authenticated returns the text of a decomposed .txt document inside allowed directories (servers/nextjs/lib/readable-local-file.ts) /api/upload-image POST authenticated writes one image (max 20 MB) to APP_DATA_DIRECTORY/uploads[/users/{id}]/<random>.png and returns its absolute filePath /api/export-presentation POST authenticated runs the bundled exporter for {format: "pdf" or "pptx", id, title}, moves the result into the user's export folder, returns {success, path: "/api/export-presentation/file?name=..."} /api/export-presentation/file GET authenticated, owner-scoped name streams the file from APP_DATA_DIRECTORY/exports with a download Content-Disposition /api/export-presentation-data/[id] GET x-export-cookie header required (exempt in proxy) proxies GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/{id} with that cookie for the headless renderer /api/update-svg GET none (exempt in proxy) recolors an SVG from /static/icons/ only; max 5 MB; returns image/svg+xml /api/github-stars GET none in handler {stars} for presenton/presenton, revalidated hourly (revalidate = 3600); 502 on failure; used by the upload page's GenerateHeader

Three of these deserve a closer look.

/api/user-config is the only path by which browser code writes provider settings. The POST forwards the raw body text to FastAPI along with the caller's cookie and, in Electron, the desktop token header (servers/nextjs/app/api/user-config/route.ts:10-37). FastAPI merges it into the stored settings and mirrors the result back to USER_CONFIG_PATH (servers/fastapi/services/provider_settings.py:137-155). The Content-Type check is a deliberate CSRF defence: a cross-site text/plain form post cannot set application/json, and tests/desktop-security.test.mjs:77-99 asserts that the original text/plain attack is rejected with 415.

/api/export-presentation validates the body strictly (non-empty JSON object, string id, format in pdf or pptx), checks bundledExportPackageAvailable(), runs runBundledPresentationExport() with the caller's cookie header, and for multi-user deployments moves the output into exports/users/{user_id}/ before building the download URL (servers/nextjs/app/api/export-presentation/route.ts:16-162). The download route refuses absolute names, backslashes, .. segments, other users' folders, and anything whose real path escapes the exports directory (.../export-presentation/file/route.ts:22-83).

/api/update-svg resolves a static icon root from PRESENTON_APP_ROOT candidates or the working directory, then defends against traversal and time-of-check races: path containment checks before and after realpath, O_NOFOLLOW on open, a size check on the open handle, and a bounded read (servers/nextjs/app/api/update-svg/route.ts:29-165). Colors and numeric attributes are normalized by lib/svg-color.ts before transformSvgMarkup() rewrites the SVG.

Gotcha

/api/upload-image saves every upload with a .png extension regardless of the real format (servers/nextjs/app/api/upload-image/route.ts:53). No code in the repository calls this route: the image editor and the chat panel upload through FastAPI's /api/v1/ppt/images/upload via ImagesApi.uploadImage() (servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/components/ImageEditor.tsx:326, .../presentation/components/Chat.tsx:1529). Treat it as a leftover rather than a second upload path.

docs.title: Step 11: lib/ and utils/ helpers
docs.text:
servers/nextjs/lib/:

File Responsibility chart-browser.ts Loads /vendor/chart-4.5.1.umd.min.js plus a datalabels plugin into the browser (loadChartBrowserRuntime()). desktop-auth.ts Electron transport guard and desktop cookie header (Step 6.6). fastapi-internal.ts Server-side FastAPI base URL and optional HTTP Basic auth headers from AUTH_USERNAME/AUTH_PASSWORD env or the config file. math.ts LaTeX normalization (max 4000 chars), KaTeX HTML rendering and SVG data-URI generation for equations. provider-setup-navigation.ts Decides ignore, warn or block for link clicks while provider setup is incomplete. readable-local-file.ts Path policy for /api/read-file: .txt only, owner-scoped directories, symlink-safe. run-bundled-presentation-export.ts Locates and runs the bundled presentation-export package. runtime-limits.ts BoundedTextBuffer (keeps the last 8192 chars of process output) and memorySnapshotMb(). runtime-provider-config.ts Redacted provider config for non-admins. server-auth-role.ts authStatusForRequest() and requireAdminApi() for API routes. smart-slide-icons.ts Icon recoloring for Smart HTML slides. svg-color.ts SVG color normalization, buildSvgUpdateUrl(), transformSvgMarkup(). tailwind-browser.ts Browser Tailwind version, script URL, scoped style. template-theme.ts TemplateTheme type, defaults, normalizeTemplateTheme(), template id resolution. template-v2-json-to-html.ts Renders Template V2 ui JSON to an HTML string at 1280 by 720 (templateV2UiToHtml()). user-config-store.ts Locked, atomic, backed-up JSON file I/O for userConfig.json. utils.ts cn() class-name merge helper.

servers/nextjs/utils/:

File Responsibility api.ts Origin selection, asset URL normalization, backend reachability (Step 7). apiErrorMessages.ts Extracts readable messages and retry metadata from FastAPI error bodies. analytics.ts sanitizeAnalyticsError() (single line, max 240 chars), bucketFileSize(), bucketMessageLength(). auth.ts, authErrors.ts, serverAuth.ts DISABLE_AUTH parsing, FastAPI detail formatting, server guards. chatgptAuth.ts ChatGPT re-auth detection, event and logout. clipboard.ts copyTextToClipboard() with an execCommand("copy") fallback. codexModels.ts Supported Codex model ids; default gpt-5.6-luna. community.ts isCommunityEnabled(). error_helpers.ts wrap_errors() re-throwing as ApiError. image-url-converter.ts Rewrites img[src] in the DOM with a MutationObserver using resolveBackendAssetUrl(). mixpanel.ts Telemetry (see Settings, onboarding, auth UI). presentationGenerationMode.ts standard, smart, both handling. presentationLimits.ts MAX_NUMBER_OF_SLIDES = 50, MAX_OUTLINE_CONTENT_WORDS = 100, clamping helpers. providerConstants.ts Text, image and web-search provider catalogs with labels, icons and key fields. providerUtils.ts Ollama discovery, caching, pull streaming, and legacy config field mapping. settingsAccess.ts getSettingsView(role): admin or account. storeHelpers.ts normalizeLLMConfig(), getLLMConfigValidationError(), handleSaveLLMConfig(). constant.ts Empty file.

docs.title: Step 12: Types
docs.text:
servers/nextjs/types/llm_config.ts:1-153 defines LLMConfig, a flat optional-field interface whose keys match the backend's environment-variable names. Groups:

Group Keys Selection LLM Hosted text providers OPENAI_*, DEEPSEEK_*, GOOGLE_*, VERTEX_*, AZURE_OPENAI_*, BEDROCK_*, OPENROUTER_* (including OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_ORDER as string[]), FIREWORKS_*, TOGETHER_*, CEREBRAS_*, ANTHROPIC_* Gateways and local LITELLM_*, LMSTUDIO_*, OLLAMA_URL, OLLAMA_MODEL, CUSTOM_LLM_URL, CUSTOM_LLM_API_KEY, CUSTOM_MODEL Images DISABLE_IMAGE_GENERATION, IMAGE_PROVIDER, PEXELS_API_KEY, PIXABAY_API_KEY, COMFYUI_URL, COMFYUI_WORKFLOW, OPEN_WEBUI_IMAGE_*, OPENAI_COMPAT_IMAGE_*, GPT_IMAGE_2_QUALITY, GPT_IMAGE_1_5_QUALITY Generation controls DISABLE_THINKING, EXTENDED_REASONING, LLM_GENERATION_PROFILE, LLM_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, LLM_REASONING_MODE, LLM_REASONING_EFFORT, LLM_REASONING_BUDGET_TOKENS Web search WEB_GROUNDING, WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER, WEB_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS, SEARXNG_BASE_URL, TAVILY_API_KEY, EXA_API_KEY, BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY, SERPER_API_KEY Codex OAuth CODEX_MODEL, CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, CODEX_REFRESH_TOKEN, CODEX_TOKEN_EXPIRES, CODEX_ACCOUNT_ID, CODEX_USERNAME, CODEX_EMAIL, CODEX_IS_PRO UI only USE_CUSTOM_URL, DISABLE_ANONYMOUS_TRACKING (string)

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/types/slide.ts:25-42 defines the client Slide: id, index, type, design_index, images, properties, icons, graph_id, optional presentation, speaker_note, layout, layout_group, html_content, ui, and content (a loose SlideContent with title, body, optional description, graph, diagram, infographics, image_prompts, icon_queries). In practice, standard slides carry their rendering in ui and Smart slides in html_content; the backend schema is in Data model.

servers/nextjs/types/presentation.ts:1-20 (GenerateRequestBody, SlideData, PresentationResponse with thumbnail and file) is a legacy shape; current pages type responses with PresentationResponse from services/api/dashboard.ts:9-33 instead. servers/nextjs/types/global.d.ts:16-32 declares window.electron (exportPresentation, readFile) and window.env (NEXT_PUBLIC_FAST_API, APP_VERSION, DISABLE_AUTH), which Electron injects at runtime.

docs.title: What you now know
docs.text:
• The build emits a standalone server into .next-build, disables image optimization in Electron, and serves fonts with open CORS; Smart slides depend on a second, browser-side Tailwind 4 runtime.
  • Pages are guarded by server layouts (requireAppSession, requireAdminSession), while proxy.ts gates /api/*, rewrites FastAPI paths at request time, hands off export sessions as cookies, and keeps sk-presenton- API keys off Next.js routes.
  • ConfigurationInitializer decides, once per mount, whether the backend is reachable, who the user is, and whether to send them to onboarding or /upload.
  • The Redux store has four slices; several presentationGeneration reducers are dead code from the legacy content-path editor.
  • Every FastAPI call goes through getApiUrl() and ApiResponseHandler, and the service tables above map each function to its endpoint.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: Follow a user through those routes request by request in User journey.

docs.title: User journey
docs.text:
Reads: servers/nextjs/app/page.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/ConfigurationInitializer.tsx, servers/nextjs/components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/upload/components/UploadPage.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/outline/components/OutlinePage.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/outline/hooks/useOutlineStreaming.ts, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/hooks/usePresentationStreaming.ts, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/components/PresentationHeader.tsx · Builds on: Next.js architecture · Time: ~40 min

This chapter follows one user from the first page load to a downloaded PPTX, and records every HTTP request, every Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream and every Redux update along the way. You will see exactly which component fires which request, what the JSON body looks like, which slice action stores the response, and how the URL carries state between pages. The standard path (upload, then outline, then presentation) is covered first, then the Smart-mode variant that skips the outline page.

All paths are relative to servers/nextjs/ unless they start with servers/. Endpoints written as /api/v1/... are FastAPI endpoints; the browser reaches them through getApiUrl() and the proxy.ts rewrite described in Next.js architecture. Endpoints written as /api/<name> without a version are Next.js route handlers under app/api/.

docs.title: The whole journey in one diagram
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant B as Browser (Next.js pages)
    participant N as Next.js route handlers
    participant F as FastAPI
    U->>B: open /
    B->>F: GET /api/v1/auth/status (server side, page.tsx)
    B->>F: POST /api/v1/auth/login (AuthGate)
    B->>F: GET /api/v1/auth/status (ConfigurationInitializer)
    B->>N: GET /api/user-config or /api/runtime-config
    B->>B: router.push /upload
    U->>B: type prompt, attach files, Generate
    B->>F: POST /api/v1/ppt/files/upload (only with files)
    B->>F: POST /api/v1/ppt/files/decompose (only with files)
    B->>F: POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/create
    B->>B: router.push /outline?id=ID
    B->>F: GET /api/v1/ppt/template/all (twice, default true and false)
    U->>B: pick a template
    B->>F: SSE GET /api/v1/ppt/outlines/stream/ID
    F-->>B: status, chunk ... complete
    U->>B: edit or reorder outlines, Continue
    B->>F: POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/prepare
    B->>B: router.replace /presentation?id=ID&stream=true&type=standard
    B->>F: SSE GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/stream/ID
    F-->>B: generation_metrics, chunk, slide_assets ... complete
    U->>B: edit slides (autosave)
    B->>F: PATCH /api/v1/ppt/presentation/slide_update
    U->>B: Export, PPTX
    B->>N: POST /api/export-presentation
    N-->>B: path /api/export-presentation/file?name=...
    B->>N: GET the file (anchor download)

docs.title: Step 1: The first request to /
docs.text:
The root route is a Server Component. It runs on the Next.js server before any JavaScript reaches the browser.

servers/nextjs/app/page.tsx (excerpt)
const page = async () => {
    if (isAuthDisabled()) {
        return (
            <ConfigurationInitializer>
                <Home />
            </ConfigurationInitializer>
        );
    }

    const status = await getServerAuthStatus();
    if (status.configured && status.authenticated) {
        return (
            <ConfigurationInitializer>
                <Home />
            </ConfigurationInitializer>
        );
    }

    return <AuthGate />;
};

isAuthDisabled() (utils/auth.ts:18) reads DISABLE_AUTH from window.env in the browser or process.env on the server and accepts 1, true, yes, on (utils/auth.ts:1). Electron sets it, so the desktop app never shows a login form. Otherwise getServerAuthStatus() (utils/serverAuth.ts:37) forwards the incoming cookie to FastAPI GET /api/v1/auth/status and normalizes the reply to {configured, authenticated, username, user_id, available, role}. A network failure becomes available: false, authenticated: false (utils/serverAuth.ts:78).

Every other page in the app lives under app/(presentation-generator)/layout.tsx, which calls requireAppSession() (utils/serverAuth.ts:94). That helper redirects to / when FastAPI is unreachable or auth is not configured, and to /?reason=unauthorized when the user is not signed in. The Auth and multi-user chapter covers the cookie and the FastAPI side.

docs.title: Step 2: Setup or login in AuthGate
docs.text:
When the server decides the visitor is not signed in, it renders AuthGate (components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx:30), a client component with two modes chosen by status.configured:

Mode Shown when Title Endpoint Password minimum Setup configured === false (no admin exists) "Create your admin login" POST /api/v1/auth/setup 8 characters, plus a matching confirm field Sign in configured === true "Sign in to continue" POST /api/v1/auth/login 6 characters

On mount the component fetches GET /api/v1/auth/status again from the browser with credentials: "include" (components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx:106). It also keeps a splash screen up for at least PRESENTON_SPLASH_MIN_DURATION_MS so the page does not flash.

Client-side validation runs before any request (components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx:170): the username is trimmed and must be at least 3 characters (the input also strips whitespace on every keystroke and has maxLength={128}), and the password must meet the mode's minimum. The request body is the same for both modes:

{ "username": "alice", "password": "correct horse" }

After a successful setup the gate does not sign the user in. It flips to sign-in mode and shows "Account created. Sign in with your new username and password to continue." (components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx:280). After a successful login the response carries authenticated: true, and an effect calls window.location.replace("/") (components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx:80), a full reload so the server re-renders / with the new cookie.

If the URL contains ?reason=unauthorized (set by requireAppSession()), the gate shows an "Unauthorized" toast (only when auth is configured and the visitor is not signed in) and strips the query string with history.replaceState (components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx:87).

Gotcha

A 401 whose detail equals UNAUTHORIZED_DETAIL is rewritten to "The username or password is incorrect. Please try again." (components/Auth/AuthGate.tsx:255). Any other 401 detail is shown verbatim, so FastAPI error strings reach the user unchanged.

docs.title: Step 3: ConfigurationInitializer decides where you land
docs.text:
A signed-in request to / renders <ConfigurationInitializer><Home /></ConfigurationInitializer>. The initializer is also mounted by the (presentation-generator) layout, so it wraps every app page. Its job is to fill the userConfig slice and enforce "no provider, no app".

fetchUserConfigState() (app/ConfigurationInitializer.tsx:205) runs once on mount:

  1. assertBackendReachable(); on failure, a "Cannot reach backend" toast and stop.
  2. GET /api/v1/auth/status to learn the role. dispatch(setUserRole("admin" | "user")) (app/ConfigurationInitializer.tsx:249).
  3. Admin branch: GET /api/user-config (the Next.js route that proxies FastAPI GET /api/v1/admin/provider-settings with real secrets), then normalizeLLMConfig() and dispatch(setLLMConfig(config)).
  4. If LLM === "presenton", GET /api/v1/auth/presenton/status to check the cloud link.
  5. Valid config: if the current route is /, router.push("/upload"). Invalid config: if the route is not / and not /settings, router.push("/") so the admin lands on onboarding.
  6. Regular-user branch: GET /api/runtime-config, which returns {configured, config} with secrets replaced by "__configured__". If configured is false the user sees "Instance not configured. Ask the administrator..." and stays put.

A second effect (app/ConfigurationInitializer.tsx:75) re-validates the provider on every route change except /, /settings and /pdf-maker. For admins an invalid config forces router.replace('/').

Home (components/Home.tsx:11) is the onboarding wizard. A non-admin who somehow lands on / is pushed to /upload (components/Home.tsx:20). Onboarding itself is described in Settings, onboarding, auth UI.

Gotcha

ConfigurationInitializer keeps the splash screen up until window.location.pathname actually equals the push target, polling every 500 ms (app/ConfigurationInitializer.tsx:191). If a push is swallowed (for example an earlier navigation wins), the polling interval is never cleared and the splash stays. When you change the redirect logic, keep the target path passed to setLoadingToFalseAfterNavigatingTo() identical to the path you push.

docs.title: Step 4: The dashboard
docs.text: /dashboard renders DashboardPage (app/(presentation-generator)/(dashboard)/dashboard/components/DashboardPage.tsx:392) inside the (dashboard) layout, which adds DashboardSidebar. The layout reads two environment variables on the server: PRESENTATION_GENERATION_MODE (the "Standard" templates link is hidden when the mode is smart) and PRESENTON_COMMUNITY_ENABLED (the Community link is hidden when it is 0, false, no or off; empty means enabled, utils/community.ts:1).

docs.title: 4.1 Listing
docs.text:
On mount fetchPresentations() fires two requests in parallel (DashboardPage.tsx:426):

Call Request Purpose DashboardApi.getPresentations("v2-standard") GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/all?version=v2-standard Current decks, with slides (first slide drives the thumbnail) DashboardApi.getPresentations("v1-standard", { includeSlides: false }) GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/all?version=v1-standard&include_slides=false Legacy decks, listed in LegacyPresentationsTable only

A 404 is treated as "no presentations" and returns [] (services/api/dashboard.ts:58). Both lists are sorted newest first by Date.parse(created_at), with unparsable dates sorted as 0 (DashboardPage.tsx:200). The grid/list toggle is local state (deckViewMode), not persisted.

docs.title: 4.2 Cards
docs.text:
PresentationCard (.../dashboard/components/PresentationCard.tsx:31) handles three actions:

Action Request Result Click card none router.push("/presentation?id=ID&type=standard") or type=smart when presentation.type or generation_mode is smart (PresentationCard.tsx:74) Delete DELETE /api/v1/ppt/presentation/{id} card removed from local state via onDeleted Duplicate POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/{id}/duplicate returned deck is prepended via onDuplicated

A v1-standard card is rendered with aria-disabled and clicking it shows "Unsupported presentation" instead of navigating (PresentationCard.tsx:60).

docs.title: 4.3 Blank presentation dialog
docs.text:
The "Blank Presentation" action card opens BlankPresentationDialog (.../dashboard/components/BlankPresentationDialog.tsx). It has two steps (DialogStep = "choice" | "templates"). Choosing a template loads the template list through useTemplateSummaries() (see Step 7). Either path calls createBlankPresentation(templateId?) (DashboardPage.tsx:452), which is guarded by a useRef flag so a double click cannot create two decks:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/services/api/presentation-generation.ts (excerpt)
      const response = await fetch(
        getApiUrl(`/api/v1/ppt/presentation/create/blank`),
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: getHeader(),
          body: templateId
            ? JSON.stringify({ template_id: templateId })
            : undefined,
          cache: "no-cache",
        }
      );

Without a template the body is omitted entirely. tests/blank-presentation.test.mjs:32 pins this: it asserts the URL ends in /api/v1/ppt/presentation/create/blank, the method is POST, the Content-Type header is application/json, and the body is undefined or {"template_id": ...}. The response must contain a string id or the client throws "Blank presentation response did not include an id". On success the user goes straight to /presentation?id=ID&type=standard, skipping upload and outline.

docs.title: Step 5: The upload page
docs.text: /upload (app/(presentation-generator)/upload/page.tsx:46) is a Server Component that reads PRESENTATION_GENERATION_MODE and PRESENTON_COMMUNITY_ENABLED and passes them as props to the client component UploadPage (.../upload/components/UploadPage.tsx:151).

docs.title: 5.1 Local state and defaults
docs.text:
UploadPage keeps everything in React state until Generate is pressed. Nothing is written to Redux while you type.

Field (PresentationConfig) Default Control slides null ("Auto slides") SlideCountSelect in ConfigurationSelects.tsx:79 language LanguageType.Auto = "Auto (English)" LanguageSelect (searchable list of every LanguageType value) prompt "" PromptInput textarea tone "default" Advanced settings verbosity "standard" Advanced settings instructions "" Advanced settings includeTableOfContents false Advanced settings includeTitleSlide false Advanced settings webSearch false, then overwritten by llmConfig.WEB_GROUNDING (UploadPage.tsx:227) no UI control on this page

ToneType values are default, casual, professional, funny, educational, sales_pitch; VerbosityType values are concise, standard, text-heavy (upload/type.ts:134).

The URL can preload state (UploadPage.tsx:179): ?prompt=... fills the prompt, ?mode=smart|standard picks the mode if the deployment allows it, and ?communityId=N (positive safe integer, community enabled, smart mode available) fetches GET /api/v1/ppt/community/presentations/{N} and preselects that design as a reference. The Community page uses these parameters (see Settings, onboarding, auth UI).

docs.title: 5.2 Prompt input and supporting documents
docs.text:
PromptInput (.../upload/components/PromptInput.tsx:23) is a plain Textarea; Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter submits (PromptInput.tsx:33). Selected community references render as removable chips above it.

SupportingDoc (.../upload/components/SupportingDoc.tsx:27) renders the paperclip and the round submit arrow. Files are filtered by extension only:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/upload/components/SupportingDoc.tsx (excerpt)
const MAX_SUPPORTED_FILES = 8;
const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = [
  ".pdf", ".txt", ".doc", ".docx", ".docm", ".odt", ".rtf",
  ".ppt", ".pptx", ".pptm", ".odp", ".xls", ".xlsx", ".xlsm",
  ".ods", ".csv", ".tsv", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif",
  ".bmp", ".tiff", ".webp",
];

Drag and drop goes through the same addFiles(). Extra files beyond 8 are dropped with a "Maximum file limit reached" warning (SupportingDoc.tsx:46). The files stay as browser File objects in local state; nothing is uploaded until Generate.

docs.title: 5.3 Slide count and language
docs.text: The slide-count popover offers presets 5, 8, 9, ... 20 plus a free numeric field (ConfigurationSelects.tsx:59). Every change goes through clampSlideCountValue() (utils/presentationLimits.ts:39): non-digits are stripped, leading zeros removed, and the value is capped at MAX_NUMBER_OF_SLIDES = 50. On submit parseLimitedSlideCount() turns null or "" into null, which the backend reads as "decide automatically".

docs.title: 5.4 Advanced settings
docs.text: AdvanceSettings (.../upload/components/AdvanceSettings.tsx:23) edits a draft copy. Changes reach config only on Save (AdvanceSettings.tsx:57); Escape or the close button discards them. While open, it sets document.body.style.overflow = "hidden".

docs.title: 5.5 Generation mode dialog
docs.text:
The "Presentation Mode" link opens GenerationModeDialog (.../upload/components/GenerationModeDialog.tsx:15): two cards with autoplaying videos (/Standard.mp4, /Smart.mp4). Hovering a card pauses the other video. The segmented control next to it does the same thing without the dialog. Availability comes from isGenerationModeAvailable() (utils/presentationGenerationMode.ts:23):

PRESENTATION_GENERATION_MODE Initial mode Smart button Standard button unset, invalid, or both standard enabled enabled standard standard disabled enabled smart smart enabled disabled

docs.title: 5.6 Community reference picker
docs.text: Only in Smart mode with community enabled, CommunityReferencePicker (.../upload/components/CommunityReferencePicker.tsx:19) loads GET /api/v1/ppt/community/presentations?page=1&page_size=8&order_by=priority&order=desc and shows the first four, filtered client side by title, author or prompt. Cmd+K or Ctrl+K focuses its search box when no dialog is open. Previewing a card calls GET /api/v1/ppt/community/presentations/{id} for full slides. "Use design" stores the selection as communityReference; "Use prompt" copies the design's prompt into the textarea.

docs.title: 5.7 What fires on Generate
docs.text:
handleGeneratePresentation() (UploadPage.tsx:410) runs in this order:

  1. validateConfiguration() (UploadPage.tsx:377): language must be set; with files attached the language may not be Auto ("Please choose a language before processing uploaded documents."); there must be a prompt, a file, or (Smart plus community) a selected reference.
  2. In Standard mode only, ensureStockImageProviderReady() (UploadPage.tsx:342): unless DISABLE_IMAGE_GENERATION is set, when the image provider is pexels or pixabay, a probe GET /api/v1/ppt/images/search?query=business&limit=1&provider=pexels&strict_api_key=true is sent, with the key in an X-Provider-Api-Key header unless it is the redacted placeholder "__configured__" (services/api/images.ts:120). A failure aborts with "Image provider unavailable".
  3. With files: handleDocumentProcessing(). Without files: handleDirectPresentationGeneration().

The document path makes three calls in sequence:

# Call Body 1 POST /api/v1/ppt/files/upload multipart/form-data, one files part per file 2 POST /api/v1/ppt/files/decompose {"file_paths": <upload response>, "language": "English"} 3 POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/create see below, with file_paths taken from the decompose response

getDocumentPaths() (UploadPage.tsx:131) flattens the decompose response and keeps every file_path string. How the backend extracts text is in Document ingestion. The create body built by PresentationGenerationApi.createPresentation() (services/api/presentation-generation.ts:82) looks like this for a prompt-only Standard run:

{
  "content": "Quarterly results for the board",
  "version": "v2-standard",
  "n_slides": 8,
  "file_paths": [],
  "language": "English",
  "tone": "professional",
  "verbosity": "standard",
  "instructions": null,
  "include_table_of_contents": false,
  "include_title_slide": true,
  "web_search": false,
  "generation_mode": "standard"
}

community_design_ids: [id] is added only in Smart mode with a selected reference. n_slides is clamped again inside the API helper to 1..50 (presentation-generation.ts:112). The helper returns the FastAPI response spread with type: generation_mode.

Then the same three Redux writes on both paths. The prompt-only path (UploadPage.tsx:568) stores files: []; the document path (UploadPage.tsx:505) stores files: responses, the raw decompose results:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/upload/components/UploadPage.tsx (excerpt)
    dispatch(setPptGenUploadState({
      config,
      files: [],
    }));
    dispatch(clearOutlines());
    dispatch(setPresentationId(createResponse.id));

pptGenUpload keeps the config and the decompose results so the outline page can regenerate later. clearOutlines() empties presentationGeneration.outlines, which matters because the outline stream only starts when that array is empty. Finally getGenerationDestination() (UploadPage.tsx:309) picks the next URL:

Mode Destination Standard /outline?id=ID Smart /presentation?id=ID&stream=true&type=smart

The overlay loader shows "Processing documents..." (90 s progress bar) and then "Generating presentation outline..." (40 s), or "Preparing outline generation..." (30 s) without files. In Smart mode the second message is "Starting Smart presentation..." on both paths. These durations only drive the fake progress bar.

Gotcha

The create call does not generate anything. It stores the request on a new presentation row and returns its id. The LLM work starts later, when the outline or presentation page opens an SSE connection. The Standard generation pipeline chapter covers the server side.

docs.title: Step 6: The documents preview page (dormant)
docs.text:
app/(presentation-generator)/documents-preview/ still exists. DocumentPreviewPage (.../documents-preview/components/DocumentPreviewPage.tsx:50) reads pptGenUpload.files, loads each extracted text through window.electron.readFile or POST /api/read-file with {"filePath": "..."}, and has its own handleCreatePresentation() that posts to /api/v1/ppt/presentation/create and then calls router.replace("/outline").

No code path navigates there any more. A search of app, components, utils, lib and store finds /documents-preview only in the dashboard Header component's active-route list (.../dashboard/components/Header.tsx:13). UploadPage decomposes documents itself and goes straight to the outline.

Gotcha

If you revive this page, note that it navigates to /outline without ?id=. OutlinePage would then fall back to presentationGeneration.presentation_id from Redux, which survives only within the same tab session. It also omits generation_mode, so it always creates a Standard deck.

docs.title: Step 7: The outline page, template stage
docs.text:
/outline renders OutlinePage (.../outline/components/OutlinePage.tsx:113). The presentation id comes from the URL first and Redux second:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/outline/components/OutlinePage.tsx (excerpt)
  const queryPresentationId = searchParams.get("id")?.trim() || null;
  const suggestedTemplate = searchParams.get("template")?.trim() || null;
  const presentation_id = queryPresentationId || storedPresentationId;

An effect copies the URL id into Redux with setPresentationId (OutlinePage.tsx:161). Without any id the page shows EmptyStateView.

The page opens in the template stage (isTemplateStage = true). TemplateSelection (.../outline/components/TemplateSelection.tsx:38) calls useTemplateSummaries(), which issues two parallel requests (hooks/useTemplateSummaries.ts:107):

GET /api/v1/ppt/template/all?page_size=100&default=true
GET /api/v1/ppt/template/all?page_size=100&default=false

When the text provider is presenton, both gain &presenton_cloud_only=true and the result is deduplicated by default|custom plus lowercased name. Templates whose layout_count is 0 are dropped. Built-in templates are reordered so momentum, dynamic, executive come first (useTemplateSummaries.ts:12). With no custom templates, a single "Templates" grid is shown; otherwise "Custom" and "Built-In" sections. The "Create custom template" card is hidden for Presenton Cloud users.

?template= in the URL preselects a template whose id matches or whose name, lowercased with non-alphanumerics replaced by -, matches (TemplateSelection.tsx:35). The user still has to click it to proceed.

Clicking a card runs handleTemplateSelect() (OutlinePage.tsx:209): it stores selectedTemplateId, sets isTemplateStage = false and scrolls to the top. That flip is what starts the outline stream.

Gotcha

The outline does not stream while the user browses templates. useOutlineStreaming(presentation_id, !isTemplateStage && hasSelectedTemplate) (OutlinePage.tsx:139) is disabled until a template is picked, so the LLM call for the outline is deferred to that moment.

docs.title: Step 8: Streaming the outline
docs.text:
useOutlineStreaming() (.../outline/hooks/useOutlineStreaming.ts:18) opens a native EventSource:

GET /api/v1/ppt/outlines/stream/{presentation_id}

It returns early when disabled, when there is no id, or when outlines already has entries (useOutlineStreaming.ts:52). That last check is why the upload page dispatches clearOutlines(). All messages arrive as the named SSE event response with a JSON data field, handled by type:

data.type Handling Redux status setStatusMessage(data.status) none chunk append data.chunk to a string buffer, run jsonrepair() on the whole buffer, JSON.parse; if the result has slides, apply limitOutlines() setOutlines(nextSlides) on every parsable chunk complete read data.presentation.outlines.slides, apply limitOutlines() setOutlines(final); close the stream closing reset state, status "Outline ready" close the stream error if the detail mentions ChatGPT auth, request re-auth; otherwise retry none

jsonrepair turns a truncated JSON prefix such as {"slides":[{"content":"# Intro into valid JSON, so each chunk renders as a growing outline. The hook also tracks which slide index changed last (activeSlideIndex) and the highest index seen; OutlineItem uses these to render the active item through marked.parse() with a 60 ms throttle (.../outline/components/OutlineItem.tsx:120) and to auto-scroll it into view.

Retries: up to MAX_STREAM_RETRIES = 3, waiting 1000 ms * retryCount (1 s, 2 s, 3 s) between attempts (useOutlineStreaming.ts:14). Each retry resets the buffer, so the server replays from the start. When retries run out, a server error event produces the toast "Outline streaming failed" and a dropped connection (onerror) produces "Connection failed".

limitOutlines() (utils/presentationLimits.ts:24) caps the list at 50 entries and each content at 100 words (MAX_OUTLINE_CONTENT_WORDS), cutting at the end of the 100th word. The setOutlines reducer applies it again (store/slices/presentationGeneration.ts:128). The SSE event format on the server side is in Streaming (SSE).

docs.title: Step 9: Editing and reordering outlines
docs.text:
While streaming, items are rendered with keys streaming-outline-{index} and dragging is disabled. After the stream ends, OutlineContent (.../outline/components/OutlineContent.tsx:40) wraps them in a dnd-kit SortableContext. Stable ids come from useStableOutlineIds() so React keys survive reorders. The pointer sensor needs 6 px of movement before a drag starts (OutlineContent.tsx:54), and the keyboard sensor uses sortableKeyboardCoordinates.

Interaction Handler Redux Drag and drop useOutlineManagement().handleDragEnd(old, new) uses arrayMove (.../outline/hooks/useOutlineManagement.ts:11) setOutlines(reordered) Click an item, edit markdown, blur OutlineItem.handleMarkdownBlur() calls onUpdate only if the draft changed (OutlineItem.tsx:90); OutlinePage.handleUpdateOutline() trims to 100 words setOutlines(updated) Tab key in the editor inserts a literal tab character none Add slide appends {content: "Outline title"}, refused at 50 (useOutlineManagement.ts:30) setOutlines([...outlines, new])

None of these edits is saved to the server immediately. They live in Redux until Continue, or until the outline assistant is used.

docs.title: 9.1 Regenerate with different settings
docs.text:
OutlinePromptBar edits a draft copy of the saved upload config (slides, language, advanced settings). "Regenerate" runs handleRegenerateOutline() (OutlinePage.tsx:223), which creates a brand new presentation with POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/create (no generation_mode, so standard), stores the draft with setPptGenUploadState, clears outlines, and replaces the URL with the new id:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/outline/components/OutlinePage.tsx (excerpt)
      // The URL owns the active ID; its sync effect updates Redux. Updating
      // Redux alone lets the previous URL restore the old ID and stalls SSE.
      const nextParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
      nextParams.set("id", createResponse.id);
      router.replace(`/outline?${nextParams.toString()}`, { scroll: false });

The new id re-runs the streaming effect, which opens a fresh EventSource. The old presentation row is left behind.

docs.title: 9.2 Outline assistant
docs.text: When a template is selected, the right rail renders <Chat variant="outline"> (OutlinePage.tsx:470). Before each message, handleBeforeOutlineChatSend() pushes the current Redux outlines to the server with PUT /api/v1/ppt/outlines/{id} and body {"slides": [{"content": "..."}]} (services/api/presentation-generation.ts:270). After the assistant changes the outline, handleOutlineChanged() reloads it with GET /api/v1/ppt/outlines/{id} and dispatches setOutlines. The chat protocol itself is covered in Editing and chat assistant.

docs.title: Step 10: Continue, prepare and navigate
docs.text:
GenerateButton (.../outline/components/GenerateButton.tsx:13) is disabled while the stream is loading or running and before a template is chosen. Its label walks through "Select a Template", "Loading...", "Continue", and the loading message. Clicking it calls usePresentationGeneration().handleSubmit() (.../outline/hooks/usePresentationGeneration.ts:87):

  1. Read the newest outlines straight from the store with store.getState() (not from a stale closure).
  2. Validate: at least one outline, a template id, at most 50 outlines.
  3. POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/prepare:
{
  "presentation_id": "7c1e...",
  "outlines": [{ "content": "## Market overview\n- ..." }],
  "layout": "<selected template id>"
}
  1. On success: dispatch(clearPresentationData()), clearTheme() removes the inline CSS variables --primary-color, --background-color, --card-color, --stroke, --primary-text, --background-text and --graph-0 to --graph-9 from #presentation-page (usePresentationGeneration.ts:66), then router.replace("/presentation?id=ID&stream=true&type=standard").

The overlay shows "Generating presentation data..." with a 30 s progress bar during the prepare call. What prepare stores (the chosen layouts per slide) is explained in From template to schema to slide.

docs.title: Step 11: The presentation page loads
docs.text:
/presentation is a client page (app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/page.tsx:7). Without ?id it shows "No presentation id found". Otherwise it renders PresentationPage (.../presentation/components/PresentationPage.tsx:144). mode, slide and stream are read by usePresentationNavigation() (.../presentation/hooks/usePresentationNavigation.ts:16-20); type and editor are read by PresentationPage itself (PresentationPage.tsx:188-198):

Parameter Meaning stream=true open the generation stream instead of fetching the saved deck (any non-empty value counts) type=smart Smart deck; also enables preloading the prepared presentation mode=present&slide=N presentation mode at slide N editor=v2 also enables preloading (PresentationPage.tsx:188)

The hooks are wired in this order: useAutoSave({debounceMs: 2000, enabled}) (PresentationPage.tsx:275), usePresentationData() (provides fetchUserSlides), usePresentationNavigation(), then usePresentationStreaming() (PresentationPage.tsx:306).

Without stream, usePresentationStreaming simply calls fetchUserSlides() (usePresentationStreaming.ts:133). That function (.../presentation/hooks/usePresentationData.ts:27) does:

  1. GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/{id} with cache: "no-store" and credentials: "include".
  2. A v1-standard deck triggers "Unsupported presentation" and router.replace("/dashboard").
  3. normalizeBackendAssetUrls(data) rewrites asset URLs for the current runtime.
  4. Resolve the template id and fetch its theme with TemplateService.getTemplateTheme(); fall back to the response theme, then DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_THEME.
  5. dispatch(setPresentationData(themedData)) and, by default, dispatch(clearHistory()) to reset undo.
  6. Load fonts with useFontLoader() and apply the theme CSS variables to #presentation-slides-wrapper.

docs.title: Step 12: Streaming the presentation
docs.text:
With stream=true, startStream() (usePresentationStreaming.ts:690) dispatches setStreaming(true), clearPresentationData() and setGenerationMetrics(null), optionally preloads the prepared deck with GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/{id} (so the template layout and theme are known before the first slide), and then opens:

GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/stream/{presentation_id}

Event handling (usePresentationStreaming.ts:315):

data.type Handling Redux generation_metrics merge counters, keeping maxima across events setGenerationMetrics(next) fonts store the font map setPresentationData({...prev, fonts}) slide_html Smart mode: build or take data.slide, html_content = data.html setPresentationData with one slide merged in chunk (a) if the chunk alone parses as one slide object with string layout, number index and object content, merge that slide; (b) also append to a buffer, jsonrepair it, and if it has slides, merge them all setPresentationData slide_assets a slide whose image and icon URLs are now resolved; warnings[].detail shown once each as "Some images could not be generated" (12 s toast) setPresentationData complete full presentation in data.presentation, or (Smart) only presentation_id, in which case fetchUserSlides({clearHistory: false}) setPresentationData, setStreaming(false) closing same as complete with data.presentation setPresentationData, setStreaming(false) error retryable === false fails immediately; otherwise retry; the message appends "N of M slides were saved and will be reused." when completed_slides > 0 setStreaming(false) on final failure

After completion the hook removes stream from the URL with history.replaceState (usePresentationStreaming.ts:610), so a page refresh loads the saved deck instead of streaming again. Retries use the same 3 attempts and linear 1 s backoff as the outline hook.

docs.title: 12.1 streamAssetMerge: never regress an image
docs.text:
Chunk events replay slides with placeholder assets even after a slide_assets event delivered the real URL. streamAssetMerge.ts prevents flicker back to the placeholder:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/utils/streamAssetMerge.ts (excerpt)
function mergeTreePreservingResolvedAssets(previous: any, incoming: any): any {
  if (incoming === undefined) return previous;

  if (
    isPlaceholderAssetUrl(incoming) &&
    isResolvedAssetUrl(previous)
  ) {
    return previous;
  }

  if (incoming === null || typeof incoming !== "object") return incoming;

A string counts as a placeholder when it contains any of /static/images/placeholder, /static/images/replaceable_template_image, /static/icons/placeholder, placeholder.jpg, placeholder.svg or replaceable_template_image.png (streamAssetMerge.ts:1). The walk is recursive over objects and arrays, so it covers both content fields and Template V2 ui trees. mergeSingleSlidePreservingResolvedAssets() (streamAssetMerge.ts:109) finds the previous slide by index (falling back to array position), merges, and re-sorts the array by index, so slides arriving out of order still display in order.

docs.title: 12.2 Rendering as content arrives
docs.text: PresentationPage renders only the selected slide in the main canvas (SlideContent at PresentationPage.tsx:929) and thumbnails in SidePanel. While isStreaming is true, an effect keeps selecting the newest slide (PresentationPage.tsx:359), so the canvas follows generation. editingDisabled = isStreaming === true (PresentationPage.tsx:204) is passed down, the thumbnail list is not sortable, the slide action bar is hidden, autosave is paused, and export and Present are disabled. The canvas shows a skeleton until the first slide exists. The overlay says "Creating your presentation" with a 90 s progress bar until the first slide lands.

docs.title: 12.3 StreamingGenerationMetrics
docs.text:
PresentationHeader renders <StreamingGenerationMetrics metrics={generationMetrics} /> (PresentationHeader.tsx:608) when metrics exist. The pill shows In, Out, optionally Think, and tokens per second. A ~ prefix and a pulsing purple dot mean the numbers are estimates; a green dot means the provider reported final usage (.../presentation/components/StreamingGenerationMetrics.tsx:40). The hook keeps input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, duration_seconds and thinking_tokens monotonic with Math.max against the previous event, except that thinking_tokens is taken as-is once the provider marks it exact (thinking_tokens_estimated === false). tokens_per_second is simply the latest value, and supports_thinking stays true once any event sets it.

Gotcha

A metrics event is ignored until it carries something non-zero or supports_thinking (usePresentationStreaming.ts:393). An all-zero first event therefore produces no pill, which is intended, not a bug.

docs.title: Step 13: Editing and autosave, briefly
docs.text: Once streaming ends, the editor is live. Every edit changes presentationData in Redux, useAutoSave waits 2 s and then sends either one PATCH /api/v1/ppt/presentation/slide_update per changed slide, a title-only PATCH /api/v1/ppt/presentation/update, or a whole-deck PATCH /api/v1/ppt/presentation/update when slides were added, removed or reordered. The header shows a saving indicator from isSaving. The diff algorithm and the editor internals are the subject of Slide editor.

docs.title: Step 14: Export and download
docs.text:
The export controls are in PresentationHeader, not in PresentationActions. PresentationActions (.../presentation/components/PresentationActions.tsx:2110) is the right-hand tool rail (AI, Blocks, Texts, Charts, Infograph, Tables, Images, Shapes; PresentationActions.tsx:212), covered in the next chapter. The header's ExportOptions popover (PresentationHeader.tsx:469) has two buttons, PDF and PPTX, wired to handleExportPdf() (PresentationHeader.tsx:308) and handleExportPptx() (PresentationHeader.tsx:226).

Both handlers return immediately while streaming, build a safe file name, and pick a runtime:

Runtime Detected by Mechanism electron window.electron?.exportPresentation exists IPC call exportPresentation(id, title, format) browser_api otherwise POST /api/export-presentation, then anchor download

buildSafeExportFileName() (PresentationHeader.tsx:62) replaces every character outside [a-zA-Z0-9\s_-] with -, collapses whitespace and repeated separators, trims them from both ends, truncates to 40 characters (MAX_EXPORT_TITLE_LENGTH) and falls back to presentation. A deck titled "Q3 Results: Final.v2" exports as Q3-Results-Final-v2.pptx.

The browser path:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/components/PresentationHeader.tsx (excerpt)
        const response = await fetch("/api/export-presentation", {
          method: "POST",
          body: JSON.stringify({
            format: "pptx",
            id: presentation_id,
            title: safePptxTitle,
          }),
        });

The route handler (app/api/export-presentation/route.ts:92) checks the session with authStatusForRequest(), validates id and format, runs the bundled exporter with the caller's cookie, moves the file into APP_DATA_DIRECTORY/exports/users/{user_id}/ when there is a user id, and returns:

{ "success": true, "path": "/api/export-presentation/file?name=users%2F<user_id>%2F<exported file name>" }

downloadLink() (PresentationHeader.tsx:426) then creates an <a href=path download=fileName rel="noopener"> (the download attribute carries the safe name, so the browser saves Q3-Results-Final-v2.pptx whatever the server-side file is called), clicks it and removes it. A loading toast is replaced by "Export complete" or "Export failed". Export lifecycle analytics are sent with trackEventImmediately (beacon transport) so they survive the download navigation. How the exporter renders slides and builds the PPTX is in PPTX and PDF export.

The header's other controls on the same path: inline title edit (updateTitle in Redux, saved by autosave), Undo and Redo, Present (?id=ID&mode=present&slide=N, plus &type=smart for Smart decks), Regenerate (only when the server set can_regenerate), and the keyboard shortcut dialog.

Gotcha

The export fetch sends no Content-Type header. The route reads the raw text with req.text() and JSON.parses it itself (route.ts:16), so this works, but do not "fix" the route to use req.json() with a content-type check, or the browser export breaks.

docs.title: Step 15: The Smart-mode variant
docs.text:
Smart mode skips the outline page and the template picker entirely.

flowchart LR
    A["UploadPage (mode smart)"] -->|"POST /api/v1/ppt/presentation/create generation_mode smart"| B["router.push /presentation?id=ID&stream=true&type=smart"]
    B --> C["usePresentationStreaming preloadPresentationData = true"]
    C -->|"GET /api/v1/ppt/presentation/ID"| D["prepared deck in Redux"]
    C -->|"SSE /api/v1/ppt/presentation/stream/ID"| E["slide_html events"]
    E --> F["slide.html_content in Redux"]
    F --> G["SlideScale renders SmartHtmlEditor or SmartHtmlSlide"]
    E -->|"complete with only presentation_id"| H["fetchUserSlides clearHistory false"]

Differences from the standard path:

Aspect Standard Smart After create /outline?id=ID /presentation?id=ID&stream=true&type=smart Stock provider probe before create yes skipped (UploadPage.tsx:422) Community reference not sent community_design_ids: [id] when selected Outline review yes no Template selection required none Preload prepared deck with editor=v2, or forced as soon as a Template V2 slide arrives while Redux has no Template V2 layout (preloadPreparedPresentation(true)) always (type=smart) Slide payload Template V2 ui JSON in chunk events HTML string in slide_html events Final event complete with full presentation complete may carry only presentation_id, then the client refetches Editor Konva surface SmartHtmlEditor (contenteditable HTML) Right rail all insert tools AI only (aiOnly in PresentationActions.tsx:2118) Header extra none "select to edit" toggle stored in localStorage["html-selector-mode"]

When a slide_html event has no slide object, the client builds one: {id: slide_id, index, layout: "smart-html", layout_group: "smart-html", content: {title: "Slide N"}, html_content: html} (usePresentationStreaming.ts:429). The rendering decision is made in SlideScale (the default export of app/(presentation-generator)/components/PresentationRender.tsx:139): any slide with a non-empty html_content string is rendered as HTML, everything else goes to the Template V2 renderer. What Smart mode does on the server is in Smart mode.

Gotcha

For Smart decks the complete handler is async and awaits fetchUserSlides() inside the EventSource listener (usePresentationStreaming.ts:585). If that fetch fails, the handler schedules a retry, which re-opens the stream. The server is expected to answer a re-opened stream for a finished deck quickly with another complete; if you change the server so it regenerates instead, a transient GET failure would trigger a second generation.

docs.title: What you now know
docs.text:
• / is a Server Component that chooses AuthGate or onboarding, and ConfigurationInitializer loads the role and provider config before any app page renders, redirecting admins with an invalid config back to /.
  • The upload page keeps all settings local, then sends optional files/upload and files/decompose, one presentation/create, and stores the config, the decompose results and the new id in Redux before navigating.
  • The outline stream starts only after a template is picked; chunks are repaired with jsonrepair, capped at 50 slides and 100 words each, and edits stay in Redux until presentation/prepare.
  • The presentation stream merges slides by index, never lets a placeholder URL overwrite a resolved one, and removes stream=true from the URL when done.
  • Export lives in PresentationHeader: Electron uses IPC, the browser posts to /api/export-presentation and downloads the returned path with a temporary anchor.
  • Smart mode goes from upload straight to a streamed presentation of HTML slides, with no outline or template stage.

docs.title: Next
docs.text: The next chapter opens up the editor you landed in at Step 13, from the component tree down to undo, autosave and keyboard shortcuts: Slide editor.

docs.title: Slide editor
docs.text:
Reads: servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/components/PresentationPage.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/components/PresentationRender.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/components/V1ContentRender.tsx, servers/nextjs/components/slide-editor/surface/TemplateV2KonvaSlide.tsx, servers/nextjs/components/slide-editor/text/TiptapInlineTextEditor.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/hooks/useAutoSave.tsx, servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/utils/autoSaveDiff.ts, servers/nextjs/store/slices/undoRedoSlice.ts · Builds on: User journey · Time: ~45 min

This chapter takes the editor apart: how a slide object in Redux becomes pixels, how a double-click turns into a Tiptap editor and then back into JSON, how images are replaced, how slides are added, moved and deleted, how the two undo systems coexist, how autosave decides what to send, and how presentation mode, wheel navigation, keyboard shortcuts and the clipboard work. The behaviors are cross-checked against the unit tests in servers/nextjs/tests/.

Paths are relative to servers/nextjs/. The editor has two slide flavors and you need to keep them apart from the start:

Flavor Data on the slide Editor Redux write Template V2 (Standard mode, blank decks) slide.ui, a JSON layout of components and elements on a 1280 x 720 canvas TemplateV2KonvaSlide (Konva canvas plus DOM overlays) updateSlideUi({index, ui}) Smart HTML (Smart mode) slide.html_content, an HTML string styled with Tailwind SmartHtmlEditor (contenteditable in place) updateSlideHtmlContent({slideIndex, slideId, html})

The Template V2 JSON format itself is documented in Template V2 format.

docs.title: Step 1: The component tree
docs.text:
flowchart TD
    A["PresentationPage (presentation/components/PresentationPage.tsx)"] --> B["PresentationHeader (title, undo, export, present)"]
    A --> C["SidePanel (thumbnails, dnd-kit)"]
    A --> D["SlideContent (active slide only)"]
    A --> E["PresentationActions (insert tools, AI chat)"]
    C --> C1["SortableSlide"] --> C2["SlideThumbnailCard"]
    C2 --> C3["TemplateV2HtmlSlidePreview or SmartHtmlSlide"]
    D --> F["SlideScale (components/PresentationRender.tsx)"]
    D --> G["SlideActionBar (blank, layouts, duplicate, move, delete)"]
    F -->|"html_content present"| H["SmartHtmlEditor or SmartHtmlSlide"]
    F -->|"otherwise"| I["V1ContentRender"]
    I --> J["SlideErrorBoundary"]
    J --> K["TemplateV2KonvaSlide (Konva Stage)"]
    K --> L["RawComponentNode and RawElementNode (surface/nodes.tsx)"]
    K --> M["ElementToolbar, SelectionToolbar, TemplateV2InlineEditor"]
    I --> N["TemplateV2PromptOverlay (blank or new-layout slides)"]

docs.title: 1.1 PresentationPage
docs.text:
PresentationPage (app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/components/PresentationPage.tsx:144) renders only the selected slide in the main canvas, not a scrolling list:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/presentation/components/PresentationPage.tsx (excerpt)
  const totalSlides = presentationData?.slides?.length ?? 0;
  const activeSlideIndex =
    totalSlides > 0
      ? Math.min(Math.max(selectedSlide, 0), totalSlides - 1)
      : 0;
  const activeEditorSlide = presentationData?.slides?.[activeSlideIndex];

selectedSlide is local React state, changed by thumbnail clicks, arrow keys, the mouse wheel, the TEMPLATE_V2_SURFACE_SELECTED_EVENT window event, and chat "follow mode". After each change an effect dispatches TEMPLATE_V2_ACTIVATE_SURFACE_EVENT with {slideIndex} on the next animation frame (PresentationPage.tsx:768) so the Konva surface for that slide claims keyboard focus.

docs.title: 1.2 SlideContent and SlideScale
docs.text:
SlideContent (presentation/components/SlideContent.tsx:34) is memoized with a hand-written comparator over 14 props (SlideContent.tsx:143). It computes canEditSlide = !editingDisabled && isStreaming !== true and renders SlideScale plus SlideActionBar.

SlideScale (app/(presentation-generator)/components/PresentationRender.tsx:10) draws every slide at its native 1280 x 720 and scales it with a CSS transform:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/components/PresentationRender.tsx (excerpt)
    if (fitToContainer) {
      if (box.w < 1 || box.h < 1) return 1;
      const sx = box.w / BASE_WIDTH;
      const sy = box.h / BASE_HEIGHT;
      return Math.min(sx, sy);
    }
    const safeWidth = Math.max(0, box.w + 20);
    if (!safeWidth) return 1;
    return Math.min((safeWidth / BASE_WIDTH) * 0.98, 1);

A ResizeObserver keeps box current. The editor passes fitToContainer, so the slide grows to fill the canvas; present mode passes presentMode, which may scale above 1. When isClickable is false a transparent z-30 div is laid over the slide to swallow clicks (PresentationRender.tsx:133). The branch that picks the renderer is the important part:

Condition Renderer slide.html_content is a non-empty string, edit mode, clickable, not present, not fixed size SmartHtmlEditor slide.html_content non-empty, any other case SmartHtmlSlide (read only) otherwise V1ContentRender, which in this snapshot always renders Template V2

docs.title: 1.3 V1ContentRender and the error boundary
docs.text:
Despite its name, V1ContentRender (app/(presentation-generator)/components/V1ContentRender.tsx:159) contains no legacy renderer. It reads slide.ui as a TemplateV2Layout, substitutes BLANK_TEMPLATE_V2_LAYOUT for blank slides, and renders:

servers/nextjs/app/(presentation-generator)/components/V1ContentRender.tsx (excerpt)
        <SlideErrorBoundary label={`Slide ${(safeSlide.index ?? 0) + 1}`}>
            <div className="relative h-full w-full">
                <TemplateV2KonvaSlide
                    layout={directLayout ?? BLANK_TEMPLATE_V2_LAYOUT}
                    isEditMode={isEditMode}
                    slideId={safeSlide.id ?? null}
                    presentationId={presentationId}
                    slideIndex={safeSlide.index ?? 0}

SlideErrorBoundary (app/(presentation-generator)/components/SlideErrorBoundary.tsx:16) is a class component. A render error in one slide shows a red box titled "Slide N render error" with the message in a <pre>, while the rest of the editor keeps working. It resets only when its resetKey prop changes (SlideErrorBoundary.tsx:37).

Gotcha

V1ContentRender does not pass resetKey, so a slide that crashed once stays in the error state until the component remounts (for example by switching to another slide and back, since only the active slide is mounted). If you fix data that caused a crash, for instance through undo, pass resetKey={slide.ui} to make the boundary recover in place.

docs.title: 1.4 TemplateV2KonvaSlide
docs.text:
TemplateV2KonvaSlide (components/slide-editor/surface/TemplateV2KonvaSlide.tsx:3399, exported as memo(TemplateV2KonvaSlideComponent)) is a 3,400-line component that owns all editing state for one slide. Its props:

Prop Purpose layout the slide's ui JSON isEditMode false makes it a static renderer slideId, slideIndex, renderIndex identity; renderIndex wins for event targeting (TemplateV2KonvaSlide.tsx:906) displayScale the scale SlideScale applied, used to place DOM overlays correctly enableViewportCulling skip rendering when off screen (isRenderActive is true when culling is off or the slide is near the viewport, TemplateV2KonvaSlide.tsx:478) historyCommand {action, token} used by the template preview editor to trigger undo/redo from outside onLayoutChange, onHistoryAvailabilityChange callbacks for the template preview editor

When the layout prop arrives and is not the object the surface last committed, the surface clones it, runs normalizeMarkdownTextInUi(), stores it as uiDraft, clears selection and inline editing, and empties its own undo and redo stacks (TemplateV2KonvaSlide.tsx:981). The Konva Stage renders MemoizedRawElementNode for root elements and MemoizedRawComponentNode for components from surface/nodes.tsx. The detailed per-element rendering rules are listed in components/slide-editor/README.md; this chapter focuses on the data flow.

docs.title: 1.5 Thumbnails are HTML, not Konva
docs.text: SlideThumbnailCard does not mount a Konva stage per thumbnail. For v2 slides shouldRenderTemplateV2HtmlPreview() (components/TemplateV2HtmlSlidePreview.tsx:205) is true and it renders TemplateV2HtmlSlidePreview, a DOM renderer of the same JSON. Smart slides use SmartHtmlSlide.
